title: Point-in-time full USD-M net-edge advisory model

hypotheses.name: liquidation_pressure_depth_recovery
hypotheses.mechanism: A forced-flow shock followed by causal depth recovery may produce a short-horizon reversal after costs.

hypotheses.name: funding_open_interest_settlement_unwind
hypotheses.mechanism: Crowded funding and open-interest changes around settlement may predict a post-settlement unwind.

hypotheses.name: beta_neutral_cross_sectional_residual
hypotheses.mechanism: Cross-sectional residual strength after removing BTC beta may have a short holding-period edge.

hypotheses.name: btc_shock_cross_symbol_response_delay
hypotheses.mechanism: Different liquid contracts may respond to a causal BTC shock with measurable, executable delay.

universe.missing_data_rule: Exclude and record NO_TRADE; never substitute a future or current value.

data_boundary.forward_start_rule: The first complete hosted segment after this preregistration and schema freeze; no HY-EXP-0013 segment is reused for HY-EXP-0014 PnL.
data_boundary.historical_data_use: D0 hypothesis and mechanical checks only
data_boundary.failed_or_gapped_segment_rule: A failed manifest, sequence gap, stale book, missing funding or missing open-interest observation is not PnL eligible.

alert_levels.all_levels: Web record; no order instruction, quantity, leverage or account risk.

promotion_gates.continuous_profitability_definition: After F1, two consecutive 30-day rolling windows must also remain positive under stress without changing the frozen specification.

failure_policy: Any failed gate eliminates this exact specification. A changed threshold, feature, cost, timing, universe rule or delivery rule creates a new experiment and new forward start.
